description: Union Dataplane health and service metrics

panels.title: Service Availability
panels.description: Percentage of deployments with all requested replicas available. 1.0 = all healthy.

panels.title: Pod Restarts (1h)
panels.description: Total container restarts in the last hour. Non-zero indicates crashlooping or OOM kills.

panels.title: Active Executions
panels.description: Current count of active workflow, node, and task executions tracked by FlyteAdmin.

panels.title: Work Queue Operations
panels.description: Operator execution operation processing rate and failure rate.

panels.title: Background Process Runs / Errors
panels.description: FlyteAdmin error rates: propeller communication failures, model transform errors, notification publish failures.

panels.title: Heartbeat Latency
panels.description: Breakdown of operator heartbeat computation: capabilities, usages, list workflows.

panels.title: Config Syncer
panels.description: Config sync cycle rate, errors, and propeller ConfigMap update count.

panels.title: Billable Usage Collector
panels.description: Billing collection cycle rate and errors. Failures mean billing data may be delayed.

panels.title: Work Queue Paused
panels.description: 1 when operator paused due to resource limits (FlyteWorkflow count or storage exceeded).

panels.title: gRPC Client Request Rate
panels.description: DP→CP gRPC client request rate by service and method (e.g. CreateWorkflowEvent).

panels.title: gRPC Client Error Rate
panels.description: DP→CP gRPC errors by method and code. Non-OK responses from the control plane.

panels.title: gRPC Client Latency (p95)
panels.description: DP→CP gRPC call latency at p95. High latency = slow control plane or network issues.

panels.title: CPU Usage by Service
panels.description: CPU usage in cores per container, stacked. Identifies resource-heavy services.

panels.title: Memory Usage by Service
panels.description: Working set memory per container. Watch for approaching limits.

panels.title: Pod Restart Count by Container
panels.description: Per-container restart events. Spikes indicate crashes or OOM kills.

panels.title: MIG Partitions In Use
panels.description: MIG GPU partitions currently in use (framebuffer allocated) vs total configured. Requires dcgm-exporter with MIG monitoring enabled.

panels.title: MIG Partitions: Used vs Total by Profile
panels.description: Used and total MIG partition count per profile type (e.g. 1g.5gb, 3g.20gb, 7g.40gb). Only visible when MIG partitions are configured.

panels.title: MIG Partition Usage Over Time
panels.description: Number of in-use MIG partitions over time, broken down by profile. A partition counts as in use when DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED > 0.

panels.title: Self-report status over time (by source)
panels.description: union_operator:connection_config_self_reported is 1 on the active source. Shows when this dataplane migrated to self_reported (from none / legacy).

panels.title: Migrated (self-reporting)?
panels.description: 1 when this dataplane self-reports its connection_config (source=self_reported) rather than relying on the legacy admin-set URL.
Task pods in Pending/Unknown, per namespace. Task pods run in per-project namespaces (not the dataplane namespace), so this is cluster-wide.
panels.title: Pending pods by namespace

panels.description: Task pods the scheduler cannot place (insufficient node capacity or untolerated taints), per namespace. The definitive 'which project's tasks are Pending'.
panels.title: Unschedulable pods by namespace

panels.description: flytepropeller time from a task node being queued to its pod running — i.e. pod scheduling time. A spike (minutes) means pods are sitting Pending.
panels.title: Node queueing latency (queued -> running)

panels.description: Runs and finalizes leaseworker is holding.
panels.title: Active leases

panels.description: Spare lease capacity on this leaseworker fleet. Near 0 => at capacity.
panels.title: Available capacity

panels.description: Actions queued in the leaseworker dispatcher.
panels.title: Dispatcher queue depth

panels.description: Dispatcher round outcomes.
panels.title: Dispatcher rounds: success vs errors

panels.description: Pending fast-task backlog against its limit. Backlog pinned at the limit = the v2 'can't place work' signal.
panels.title: FastTask backlog vs limit

panels.description: Fast-task assignment failures: no capacity or no workers available => tasks wait.
panels.title: Task assignment (no capacity / no workers)
ResourceQuota utilization by namespace/resource
panels.description: used/hard for every project ResourceQuota (e.g. project-quota). 1.0 = saturated → pod creations rejected with 'exceeded quota', which stalls that namespace's runs.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, resource) (kube_resourcequota{type="used", resourcequota="project-quota"} / ignoring(type) kube_resourcequota{type="hard", resourcequota="project-quota"})

panels.title: Top-saturated quotas (now)
panels.description: Instant snapshot, highest first. Watch limits.cpu especially.

targets.expr: topk(20, max by (namespace, resource) (kube_resourcequota{type="used", resourcequota="project-quota"} / ignoring(type) kube_resourcequota{type="hard", resourcequota="project-quota"}))

panels.title: CPU-limit quota: used vs hard
panels.description: Absolute CPU-limit accounting. used pinned to hard = deadlock risk.

panels.title: Namespaces ≥90% on any quota (count)
panels.description: Blast-radius counter — how many project namespaces are near saturation.

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, resource) (kube_resourcequota{type="used", resourcequota="project-quota"} / ignoring(type) kube_resourcequota{type="hard", resourcequota="project-quota"}) >= 0.9)
